(185)༄༅/ /chos drug bdud rtsi nying khu'i sngon 'gro dngos grub myur stsol bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (185)༄༅// chos drug bdud rtsi nying khu'i sngon 'gro dngos grub myur stsol bzhugs so//

(186)༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhi hūm̐/ rab 'byams dkyil 'khor kun bdag 'khor lo'i mgon// rdo rje 'chang dbang dpal ldan karma pa// rnam kun 'bral med rigs kyi bdag por brten// dgongs pa 'grol zhing rjes su gnang bar gsol// de la 'dir rgyal ba kun gyi thugs bcud rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam rmad du byung ba zab mo nā ro chos drug ces grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyi snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ma nyams pa gang zag las dang skal bar ldan pa dag gis nyams su len pa'i rim pa la/ dang po thun mong gi sngon 'gro dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa/ 'chi ba mi rtag dran pa/ las 'bras rnam par smin tshul/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs la blos gzhigs pa bcas nges 'byung gi bsam pa brtan po sngon du btang*/ de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la/ thog mar skyabs sems ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho ྅haṃ/ zhes pas gzung 'dzin snang zhen gyi chos rnams stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las khams gsum gyi sa bon nā da sum brtsegs steng ma dkar po mar me mi g.yo (187)ba lta bu/ bar pa dmar po rtse mo phyogs bcur g.yo ba srin bu sad pa lta bu/ 'og ma sngon po nas 'bru lta bu'i dbyibs shin tu g.yo zhing sgra dang bcas par gsal ba'i/ steng ma bar pa la thim pas rang gi spyi bo nas skra mtshams yan grub/ 'og ma bar pa la thim pas snying ga nas rkang mthil gyi bar grub/ bar pa lan gsum g.yos pas skra mtshams nas snying ga'i bar grub par bsgom la/ stong las khams gsum ngo bo nā da'i gzugs// dkar dmar sngo brtsegs yas man 'dus pa las// skra mtshams yan dang snying ga phyin chad grub// bar pa g.yos pas de bar grub pa'i mdun// zhes gsal gdab/ mdun du rin po che'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ seng ge'i khri padma nyi zla'i gdan la bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can la brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/

mdun du pad nyi la yi dam 'khor lo sdom par rgyud sde'i lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ g.yas su pad zla la sangs rgyas shākya thub par phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis bskor ba/ rgyab tu pad zla la sher phyin mar chos dkon mchog gis bskor ba/ (188)g.yon du pad zla la rgyal sras dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma srung ma'i tshogs bcas bzhugs par bsgoms la/ gzhal med khang dbus dkon mchog lnga tshom gsal// de la rtse gcig gus pas skyabs 'gro bya// bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sems can kun// dus 'di nas bzung byang chub bar// dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyan 'khor lnga// gcig bsdus chos phung brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong 'byung gnas 'phags pa yi// dge 'dun bdag nyid rtsa brgyud kyi// bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can// dpa' bo dang ni dpa' mo'i tshogs// kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// zhes lan mang du brjod/ de nas sems bskyed pa ni/ oṃ badzra sa twa oṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur/ oṃ badzra sa twa āḥ thugs kar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar gyur// de nas thun mong min pa'i tshangs gnas bzhi 'don sgom sbrag pa ni/ oṃ sems can thams cad rdo rje chags pas rjes su chags par gyur cig /oṃ sems can thams cad rdo rje bsdam pas rjes su bsdam par gyur cig /oṃ sems can thams cad rdo rje bde ba chen pos yang dag par myos par gyur cig /oṃ sems can thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor sbyor bas rjes su grol bar gyur cig /ces mang du brjod/ oṃ badzra sa twa hūm̐/ zla gdan gyi steng du don dam byang sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba'i rnam par gyur/

de nas/ sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du// sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig che// e waṃ rang bzhin 'ba' zhig pa// rdo rje snying por bdag bskyed do// zhes mang du brjod la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /phyag rgya chen po 'grub=(189)sogs dge bsngo bya'o// rdor sems ni/ rang gi spyi bor zla gdan gyi steng 'od kyi gur khang gi dbus su bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' 'od kyi sku can kha dog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas kyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas dril bu dkur brten pa 'gying ba dang bcas pas bzhugs pa la mos gus dur byas pas/ de'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'o ma lta bu byung rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang bas rnam smin gyi phung po gdos bcas kyi cha sbrul gyi shun pa brjes pa ltar song*/ lus phyi nang sgrib med shel gong phyis pa ltar gyur/ thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag par mos la ngag tu/ spyi bor zla gdan 'od kyi gur khang dbus// bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' rab dkar ba// de la mos gus byas pas bdud rtsi babs// rnam smin lus sbyangs sdig sgrib dag par gyur// ces brjod pas gsal btab nas yi ge brgya pa mang du 'don/ mthar rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid la thim par mos te thun bsdu'o// de nas tshogs gnyis rdzogs byed maṇḍal ni/ gnas khang mdzes par brgyan/ stegs kyi khar rin po che sogs kyi maṇḍal skyon med la dri bzang dang bcas pa'i me tog tshom bu so bdun ma lag len ltar bkod pa dang*/ mchod pa ci 'byor yang bsham/ rang nyid he ru ka dpa' bo gcig pa'i skur bsgoms pa'i mdun du/ skyabs yul gyi skabs ltar dkon mchog lba tshom spyan drangs te bzhugs par mos pa'i drung du/ sems can thams cad bcom ldan 'das ma'i ngo bo lha mo bcu drug tu gyur pas/ dngos 'byor yid sprul gyi mchod pa rgya chen pos mchod par bsam la/

de nyid gsal gdab pa ni/ rang nyid he ru kar gsal (190)mdun gyi mkhar// dkon mchog rgya mtsho spyan drangs bzhugs pa'i drung*// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang rab 'byams kyis// 'gro kun mchod lhar gyur pas mchod par gyur// sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma'i drung*// gling bzhi ri rab bcas pa dang*// gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgyad pa// bye ba 'bum dang dung phyur bcas// maṇḍal gcig tu bsdus nas na// mos blos gong ma rnams la 'bul// 'gro tshogs sgo gsum longs spyod dang*// dge tshogs 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol// khang bzang rta babs bsil khang rang*// khrus khang bsro khang ldum pa dang*// skyed tshal gdan khri bla bre gdugs// rgyal mtshan ba dan rnga bsil yab// chu bzhi me tog bdug spos dang*// snang gsal dri chab zhal zas mchog /rol mo sku khrus na bza' brgyan// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya dang*// gzims mal bang mdzod gter lo tog /rdzing bu ba mchog dpag bsam shing*// bzhon pa rtsed 'jo bkra shis brgyad// rin chen sna bdun bcas pa 'bul// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// stong chen rtogs par byed pa'i ro// dri chu dri chen rakta dang*// khu klad bde chen 'bar ba'i ro// mi rta khyi ba glang po'i sha /ye shes bdud rtsir dag pa can// dpal ldan bla ma mchog la 'bul// zhes grangs ci rigs brjod cing*/ tshom bu kha gso// de nas bdun rnam dag ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag (191)gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog

/ces brjod/ tshogs zhing 'od zhu bdag dang dbyer med cing*// dge bas bde chen rdo rje'i gnas thob shog /ces bya'o// de nas byin rlabs myur 'jug bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi rim pa sogs gzhung du gsal ba ltar nyams su len par bya'o// de ltar sngon 'gro'i rim pa rnam 'dren dpa' bo rin po che'i bkas bskul ltar/ rje chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis bsgrigs pa sor bzhag la/ slar yang dang po'i las can rnams 'jug bde'i phyir cung zad gsal bar bkod pa po ni si tu padma nyin byed dbang po'o/// /maṅga laṃ// (192)
